a: Money in Pidgin is often simply money or ego.
Market means market; also bargaining context.
Oga means boss or senior person.
Madam is respectful address for a woman.
Aboki can mean friend (from Hausa usage in broader Naija talk).
Take time means be careful or go slowly.
Manage means make do with what is available.
E be so means that's how it is.
